question: After the current session-thread and grouping work, should this issue remain the broad tracker for CLI/TUI lifecycle, topic metadata, and import/export, or should maintainers split those residual slices into narrower canonical issues?
rationale: The remaining behavior is useful but spans product UX, protocol, persistent state, and multiple clients, so automation should not choose the permanent scope or data model.

options.title: Keep broad residual tracker
options.body: Keep this issue open as the umbrella while routing implementation through narrower linked issues or PRs for each accepted slice.

options.title: Split and close umbrella
options.body: Designate or create separate canonical issues for CLI, TUI, metadata, and import/export, then close this issue after those links preserve the remaining scope.

options.title: Declare current scope enough
options.body: Treat current Web UI/sidebar/picker/TUI picker support as sufficient and explicitly leave the remaining topic-family and import/export scope out of core.

recommendation.title: Keep broad residual tracker
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the umbrella while routing implementation through narrower linked issues or PRs for each accepted slice.
